title: Effects of Barley Green in Patients With Hyperuricemia
brief_summary: This experiment evaluates the effect of Barley Green in patients with hyperuricemia ， and explores the effect of Barley Green on metabolic indexes such as uric acid, blood lipids, blood glucose, free fatty acids。130 adult participants , age 18 to 65 years, will be randomized into one of the two arms. Arm A (control group) will receive dietary guidance. Arm B will receive dietary guidance and Barley Green.
